questions.question: Sam had 7 pencils. His friend gave him 3 more pencils. Then, Sam lost 2 pencils. How many pencils does Sam have now?

8 is the correct number of pencils Sam has now.

questions.hint: First add the pencils given, then subtract the pencils lost.
